title: Challenges
summary: Twelve fill-in-the-blank programs. Replace ???, press Run.

lessons.title: Two Sum
lessons.goal: Find two indexes whose values add to 9. Print them on one line, like 0 1.

lessons.title: Reverse digits
lessons.goal: Reverse 123 so the program prints 321. Fill in the loop.

lessons.title: Palindrome
lessons.goal: 121 reads the same forwards and back. Print yes if n is a palindrome.

lessons.title: Maximum
lessons.goal: Walk the array and print the largest value, 9.

lessons.title: Factorial
Fibonacci
lessons.goal: Print the 8th Fibonacci number, 21. F1 is 1, F2 is 1.

lessons.title: Fizz Buzz
lessons.goal: For 1 through 15, print Fizz, Buzz, FizzBuzz, or the number. One per line.

lessons.title: Plus one
lessons.goal: The digits 1, 2, 3 are a number. Add one and print 1 2 4.

lessons.title: Single number
lessons.goal: Every value appears twice except one. Print the unique value, 3.

lessons.title: Climb stairs
lessons.goal: You can take 1 or 2 steps. How many ways to climb 4 stairs? Print 5.

lessons.title: Valid parens
lessons.goal: Count ( and ). Print valid if they nest correctly for (()()).

lessons.title: Move zeroes
lessons.goal: Keep the order of non-zero values, then zeros. Print 1 3 12 0 0.
